meta.source: Coded from the published QP and mark scheme (4MA1_2H_2311). Derived metadata only. No exam question text transcribed.

coding_notes: CROSSOVER BLOCK CONFIRMED: 2F q17-q26 = 2H q1-q10, ten questions worth 40 marks. Coded in the same sitting as IGCSE-NOV23-F-P2.

GAP-CANDIDATE calculus_kinematics — q18, 4 marks. Displacement is given as a cubic in t and the time at a stated ACCELERATION is wanted, so it needs differentiating twice (spec 3.4 E, the one calculus item with its own worked example in the specification). FIRST sighting: this candidate had zero across the first thirteen papers. UNTAGGED — nothing in data/skills.ts covers any part of differentiating, and kinematic_graphs would be a false claim because there is no graph and no area or gradient being read.
GAP-CANDIDATE domain_and_range — q19(a), 1 mark, the value excluded from a domain. Tagged functions_notation as an INTERIM measure, as on Jun24 1H q15(a). SECOND sighting.

q23 is a FRUSTUM, and it overturned an exclusion. frustum had been removed from the iGCSE courses on 2026-10-08 as absent from both the specification text and the first twelve coded papers. The spec never writes the word, but 4.10 gives the right circular cone and a frustum is one cone removed from another — a composite of listed content. Now restored to igcse_higher. See data/courses.ts.

q20 tagged areas_of_compound_shapes with area_of_a_circle: an equilateral triangle minus its inscribed circle, the same configuration as Nov24 2H q25 but with a numeric side rather than an algebraic radius.
q14 tagged simultaneous_equations: the method is to draw the second line and read the intersection, which is the graphical route the spec names rather than algebraic elimination.
